observations.operation: Native frame navigation after a complete same-session scan
observations.precondition: A successful scan or prescan in the same driver session is required; fresh-session advance stalled and required a supervised power-off recovery.

observations.user_observation: User confirmed strip came out normally and reloaded it.

notes.nudge: 2026-10-31 supervised: 20 steps back moved the frame 1.20 mm (28.4 px at 600 dpi, about 16.6 steps per mm); 20 forward returned within 0.11 mm; same frame throughout.
notes.exposure_range: 2026-10-31 supervised: 1800 dpi 16-bit at exposure 120/168/269 (from the measured film base) scanned normally; response linear (base came out 0.84/0.855/0.856 for a 0.85 target). Range kept to 300 because nothing above 269 was scanned.
notes.calibrate: Selector 17 returned zeros twice on 2026-10-31, while the scanner was in a state poked by the IO_PORT close bug (services/native_bridge/vendorfix.h); not retested since. CyberScan measures the film base from its own scan instead.
